annotation.title_clean: FAR Part 52—Solicitation Provisions and Contract Clauses
annotation.title_en: FAR Part 52—Solicitation Provisions and Contract Clauses
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council (GSA, DoD, NASA), United States
annotation.summary_en: Part 52 of the US Federal Acquisition Regulation, setting out instructions and full text of standard solicitation provisions and contract clauses for federal procurement (ethics, kickbacks, lobbying, SAM registration, Buy American, etc.). It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prescribes how provisions and clauses are numbered, incorporated by reference, modified and dated
Sets text of anti-kickback, gratuities, contractor ethics and whistleblower clauses
Requires SAM registration and annual representations and certifications
Includes Buy American clauses for supplies and construction materials
Matrix of provisions by contract type is hosted at acquisition.gov
